entities.summary: Giusto Bellavitis was an Italian mathematician, senator, and municipal councilor. According to Charles Laisant,His principle achievement, which marks his place, in the future and the present, among the names of geometers that will endure, is the invention of the method of equipollences, a new method of analytic geometry that is both philosophical and fruitful.
